name: ^identity\.tracer\.startSpan$
reason: OpenTelemetry tracer call; the twin checks the span name, start time, attributes and parent context.

name: ^tracked\.otelSpan\.(setAttributes|setStatus|recordException|end)$
reason: OpenTelemetry span calls; the twin checks the attributes, status code and message, error and end time.

name: ^phaseSpan\.end$
reason: OpenTelemetry span call; the twin checks the end time.

name: ^controller\.close$
reason: Platform ReadableStream controller of the SSE body; the call can throw once the client has cancelled and the code ignores that.

name: ^obsState\.has$
reason: Membership test on the gateway's WeakMap of observability sockets; the language builtin.

name: ^messages\.stop$
reason: Stops the NATS consumer behind a live observability stream; the broker client is outside the runtime.

name: ^\(await connection\(\)\)\.jetstream$
reason: NATS client call that opens JetStream on the gateway's connection.

name: ^\(await connection\(\)\)\.jetstream\(\)\.views\.kv$
reason: NATS client call that opens the spent-ticket key-value bucket; the broker is outside the runtime.

name: ^\(await bucket\(\)\)\.(create|delete)$
reason: NATS key-value write; create fails when the key exists, which the twin reads from the error.

name: ^controller\.abort$
reason: Platform AbortController of one hosted batch; aborting it reports nothing back.

name: ^abortSignal\.removeEventListener$
reason: Platform AbortSignal listener removal; nothing reads its answer.

name: Event
reason: DOM Event handed to an abort listener; the listeners here never read it.

name: ^ctx\.addIssue$
reason: Zod validation context the schema library supplies; the twin checks the issue passed and reads no answer.
